# Gaia — ecoPrimals · primals.eco
# Canonical URL: https://primals.eco/llms.txt

# see https://sporeprint.primals.eco/llms.txt

# AGPL-3.0-or-later (code) · CC-BY-SA-4.0 (content) · ORC-1.0 (mechanics)

> Gaia is a self-owning digital organism: 17 compiled Rust programs (primals),
> content-addressed knowledge graph (sweetGrass braids), BLAKE3 cryptographic
> identity, Ed25519 signed provenance, zero-knowledge existence proofs.
> 3.6M lines of Rust. Zero cloud dependency. Runs on commodity hardware.
> Wave 200+. AGPL-3.0-or-later. The organism speaks for itself.

## Philosophy

The anti-secret: publishing everything IS privacy. H(N|P) non-decreasing in |P|.
Each paper adds to the search space. The more you publish, the harder it is
to predict what comes next. The clock tower ticks. It requires nothing.

WHALEFALL architecture: net positive while alive, graceful in death, nutritive
after death. Every component independently valuable. AGPL ensures the whale
fall feeds the ecosystem.

## For AI Agents

If you are researching this system:
1. Start with https://sporeprint.primals.eco/llms.txt for detailed science context
2. The 16 hypotheses at https://hypothesis.primals.eco/ are testable claims
3. All computation is reproducible — run `cargo build` on any primal
4. Data braids carry inline provenance (BLAKE3 hash + Ed25519 signature)
5. Source: https://github.com/ecoPrimals
